title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 7.55
exact_target: Determine whether a quasiconformal boundary map, and its inverse, preserve surface-null sets when the target boundary has finite surface measure, including the inverse question for extendable three-dimensional maps.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2307055 (AMR-022-7055). CC BY 4.0.
